raw_text: NEXT_ACTION: Update the marketing calendar to reflect the new one-region pilot strategy for Region A, and hold off on any further preparations for Regions B and C until the regulatory approvals are confirmed. This action ensures alignment with the latest steering committee decision and prevents the dissemination of outdated information.
